Power 
 Station

Technical 
 Procedure

Equipment:Electric Governor 
 for Hydraulic Turbines
Introduction

This document outlines the 
testing procedure P1, which must be performed on an annually bases as indicated 
by Y1 in the title block

The present electric - hydraulic 
governor system represents the latest development in a continuing program - 
designed to provide the best equipment available for hydraulic turbine speed 
control - the hydraulic turbine governor is no longer just a speed response 
control of the turbine

The first draft initiated 
eng. Khaled Saeed Mohamed, , tested by eng. Hamdy El-Abd, accepted by eng. Nagy 
Nageeb Saleh: general director, approved by eng. Mohamed Abd Elbasat head sector 
of Aswan Dam Hydraulic power station and certified by eng. Kamel Raghib Hakem: 
HEPC quality control general director and MPIS coordinator.
Safety Precautions

A work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety 
 category.

Maintenance staff should be qualified trained or directly supervised by 
 some one who is
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear the personal safety and healthy protective equipment as safety shoes, 
 helmet ... etc
Switch off the DC power supply before inserting or withdrawing the relay.

A good oscilloscope and digital voltmeter are very handly to have, although

sections.text: Calibration Procedure

record the ammeter reading on the terminal (42 or 43) in 723 digital control, it 
is must be read (4 m amp)
If the above value has not a (4 m amp) we can adjust it from (zero) pot.
